svg.aria-label: Where zellij-reaper keeps its files. On Linux the settings are ~/.config/zellij-reaper/config.toml, the log and the lists are in ~/.local/state/zellij-reaper, and the timers are systemd user units in ~/.config/systemd/user. On macOS the settings and the log are in the same places, and the timers are launch agents in ~/Library/LaunchAgents. On Windows the settings are in %APPDATA%\zellij-reaper, the log and the lists in %LOCALAPPDATA%\zellij-reaper, and the timer is a task in the Task Scheduler. zellij's own files are only read, except by recover.
